title: Stable ranges: the full algebra and the correct signs
scope: An exact local roof example and algebraic generator maps; not a picture of a finite ergodic base.

crossed_product_maps.full_center: Z(R)=Z(Q_0)=L-infinity(Omega); chi restricts to f -> f composed with T^(-1)
crossed_product_maps.coarse_type: P, Q, Q_0 and R have the same homogeneous coarse type I, II or III; this assertion does not include R crossed_chi Z. Finer subtypes are not asserted.
crossed_product_maps.normal_inverse: Explicit regular coordinate unitaries, identity-multiplicity compression, and cocycle multiplication
crossed_product_maps.proof: ../../OA-FLOW-SR.html; Sections 3, 5, 6 and 7 (sr-iw, sr-cross, sr-center, sr-type), AC3, AC6-AC7, SR19-SR33.
